data.name: Cold Email Drafting
data.one_liner: Writes multi-step cold email sequences tuned to the vertical and the product/service.
data.description: The first written touch to a stranger. Give it a campaign, a segment and how many steps you want; it drafts every step in your voice, five subject lines per step, and files the sequence for approval before anything sends.

covers.label: Outreach writing — the first written touch to a stranger

replaces.what: An agency retainer that sends the same template to everyone

human_led.your_role: You brief it, it drafts one sequence, you send.
human_led.atlas_role: Drafts one sequence from your brief and stops.

assisted.your_role: Approve every new sequence before launch and own the offer itself.
assisted.atlas_role: Every sequence lands in Drafts for approval; approved sequences send through the outreach sender with warm-up, quiet hours and bounce auto-pause.

autonomous.your_role: Review the weekly report; correct a sequence that drifts.
autonomous.atlas_role: Sequences per campaign, A/B variants, reply data feeds the next round. Bounce > 5% drops back to assisted.

data.your_role: Approve every new sequence before launch and own the offer itself. Once a sequence is proven, AI varies it within the approved frame.

one_step_further.summary: When a sequence is approved, Atlas can queue the follow-up and the inbox watch so nothing waits on you.

steps.label: Queue the day-3 follow-up
steps.does: Drafts the no-reply nudge for every step in this sequence.

steps.label: Watch the inbox for replies
steps.does: Starts Inbox Triage on this campaign's thread so hot replies get two slots within minutes.

files.title: Business profile
files.ask_prompt: What is your company and what do you do, in one line?

files.title: Offer
files.ask_prompt: What makes you different from the obvious alternative, and which products should this sell?

files.title: Ideal customer
files.ask_prompt: Who is this for, and who is it not for?

files.title: Proof
files.ask_prompt: What proof can I show — numbers, names, before/after?

hands_off_to.name: Richard
hands_off_to.role: when the channel switches to LinkedIn

campaign.description: Used to key the drafts: outreach.<campaign>.step{n}

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: Anything the sequence must say or never say.
